budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Green Community Committee is waiting for its first check, a 28% share, in the stated amount.
budget_items.quote: they are waiting for their first check for 28%, in the amount of $38,000.

budget_items.quote: they will give us up to $2.25 per square foot for them.
